decisions.reason: The approval sequence already refers generically to the other agreed formats, so replacing DXF with SLDDRW does not require changing its state.
The source message separately changes the 3D model package, and that change is already represented by a complete same-message MODIFY.
Changing the drawing file formats does not alter the required color treatment of drawing views.
The drawing file-format decision does not change the bushing arrangement, retention, fit, or motion.
The file-format change does not affect assembly-aligned drawing numbering.
The required ČSN/EN drawing standards remain applicable regardless of the exported drawing formats.
The export-format package does not modify the client-supplied drawing setup reference.
The required 120-degree hole spacing is unaffected by the drawing file formats.
The drawing file-format decision does not alter the main-shaft material, premachining, welding, or final-machining process.
Omission of the main-shaft keyway remains unchanged by the drawing export formats.
The drawing file-format change does not alter any specified part material.
The required sliding-mandrel keyway is independent of the drawing file package.
